text:
Situation: Carbamazepine 200 mg tablets (NDC 72603088701) are low at Corvale East with 70 tablets (9.2 days) and moderate at Corvale General with 153 tablets (19.9 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 26 tablets (14.1 days). No system-wide shortage is declared.

Why (FDA record): As of 2026-10-21, FDA's drug shortage list does not include carbamazepine. A separate FDA shortage entry dated 2025-12-19 notes Takeda Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. plans to discontinue carbamazepine extended-release capsules (NDC 54092-171-12), a different dosage form and manufacturer. The label for NDC 72603088701 identifies Umedica Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. (FEI 3008460260) as the registered manufacturing plant.

Our position: Supply is adequate at Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside to support a targeted transfer. No alternative manufacturer on the ranked list has a verifiable plant identified on its label, and none appear on FDA's shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 37 tablets of carbamazepine 200 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Monitor FDA shortage list and manufacturer communications weekly — requires buyer to report changes to the committee.

Not recommended: Purchasing from Ajanta Pharma USA Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, or Apotex Corp. at this time due to unverified manufacturing sites and no FDA shortage listing to justify emergency procurement.
